tasks.subject: Task 1: OBS per-endpoint request counters
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Count every OBS HTTP request by a stable operation label, exposed via Client.MetricsSnapshot().

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/client.go, backend/internal/obs/client_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** get/getFile/post take op arg and increment per-op counter; every public method passes a stable op label; PackageIsContainer increments is_container; MetricsSnapshot returns a copy; existing obs tests pass.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/client.go", "backend/internal/obs/client_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["get/getFile/post take op arg and increment per-op counter", "every public method passes a stable op label; PackageIsContainer increments is_container", "MetricsSnapshot returns a copy", "existing obs tests pass"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Publish-flag detection, cache, and eviction
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Client.ProjectPublishFlags(project) resolves per-repo publish-enabled from _meta, cached forever (fetch-once) with an explicit eviction method.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/client.go, backend/internal/obs/client_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** Publishes resolves default/bare-disable/per-repo/most-specific-wins; ProjectPublishFlags fetches once and caches permanently; EvictPublishFlags forces refetch; fetch uses publish_flags op label.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run 'TestPublishFlags|TestProjectPublishFlags' -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/client.go", "backend/internal/obs/client_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run 'TestPublishFlags|TestProjectPublishFlags' -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Publishes resolves default/bare-disable/per-repo/most-specific-wins", "ProjectPublishFlags fetches once and caches permanently", "EvictPublishFlags forces refetch", "fetch uses publish_flags op label"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Settled helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure function deciding when a package has nothing left for the worker to observe.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/settled.go, backend/internal/obs/settled_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** published/failed terminal; broken/unresolvable/building/blocked not; succeeded terminal iff all active targets published or non-publishing repo; skip-state targets ignored.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestSettled -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/settled.go", "backend/internal/obs/settled_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestSettled -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["published/failed terminal; broken/unresolvable/building/blocked not", "succeeded terminal iff all active targets published or non-publishing repo", "skip-state targets ignored"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:** Package.Settled field added; settled column in schema + additive migration + table rebuild; UpsertPackageState writes settled; scanPackages reads it; GetActivePackages returns only settled=0.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Working-set removal via Settled
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The worker removes a package from the working set when it is settled (publish-aware), and persists the flag.

**Files:** backend/internal/worker/worker.go, backend/internal/worker/worker_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** ProcessOnce computes settled via obs.Settled with cached flags and sets pkg.Settled; flags default to publishes-all on error (no wrong drop); settled persisted via the existing upsert; succeeded-non-publishing and failed removed; publishing-unpublished and type-unknown retained.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/worker/ -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/worker/worker.go", "backend/internal/worker/worker_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/worker/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ProcessOnce computes settled via obs.Settled with cached flags and sets pkg.Settled", "flags default to publishes-all on error (no wrong drop)", "settled persisted via the existing upsert", "succeeded-non-publishing and failed removed; publishing-unpublished and type-unknown retained"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: BlockedReasonTask guard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Skip the OBS call in BlockedReasonTask when the package has no blocked target.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/tasks.go, backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** no HTTP call when no blocked target; still calls and populates BlockedBy when a blocked target exists.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBlockedReasonTask -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/tasks.go", "backend/internal/obs/tasks_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ -run TestBlockedReasonTask -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no HTTP call when no blocked target", "still calls and populates BlockedBy when a blocked target exists"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Evict publish-flag cache on project removal
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Clear a project's cached publish flags when it is removed by the poller GC or the MQ project.delete handler.

**Files:** backend/internal/obs/poller.go, backend/internal/mq/consumer.go, backend/internal/obs/poller_test.go

**Acceptance Criteria:** poller GC evicts publish flags per removed project; MQ project.delete evicts publish flags; evict forces refetch.

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ ./internal/mq/ -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backend/internal/obs/poller.go", "backend/internal/mq/consumer.go", "backend/internal/obs/poller_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "cd backend && go test ./internal/obs/ ./internal/mq/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["poller GC evicts publish flags per removed project", "MQ project.delete evicts publish flags", "evict forces refetch"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Telemetry reporter package

**Acceptance Criteria:** Diff returns per-op and total deltas, omitting zero; tick refreshes baseline always, emits only when enabled; Run loops on ticker until ctx cancel.
